user.title: Choose setup type
user.description: Smart Shading moves covers only when the sun reaches their facade and the selected sun source confirms it. Easy uses a short setup with safe profile defaults. Advanced adds schedules, temperature stages, Night, pauses, safety and individual targets. Safety functions and manual control always take priority.

choose_advanced_features.description: Base shading is ready. Every selection activates that feature for this room immediately, then the wizard opens its settings one after another. There is no second enable switch. Unselected features stay hidden.

data.safety: Use wind, frost or window safety
data.glare_protection: Use glare protection for an area or object
data.test_tools: Show test and day preview tools

data_description.schedule: Prevents unnecessary movements when the room does not need automatic shading. You can choose months, weekdays and a daily time window.
data_description.temperature: Uses the measured room temperature to move between comfort, solar and heat protection. The room therefore reacts to actual heat instead of the sun position alone.
data_description.night: Uses dedicated night targets and hands control back to daytime automation in the morning. An entity or sunset and sunrise can define the night period.
data_description.safety: Gives wind, frost or window signals priority over comfort. When danger is reported, Smart Shading blocks movement or moves to configured safe targets.
data_description.conditions: Adds weather and occupancy signals so comfort movements happen only when conditions fit. Safety and heat-protection rules keep priority.
data_description.glare_protection: Protects a defined area such as a screen, table or seat from direct sun. Smart Shading calculates the required position from the sun, window and protected zone.
data_description.test_tools: Shows preview and calculation tools for checking decisions without sending a movement command.
data_description.expert_execution: Adjusts command spacing, queues and target verification. This helps with slow drives, large groups or unreliable feedback.

data_description.group_ids: Choose every cover group in this sector that this zone may protect.
data_description.calculated: Calculates the position automatically from the sun, window and protected zone.

data_description.distance_m: Distance from the facade plane to the protected viewing area.
data_description.lower_height_m: Lower edge of the protected vertical range.
data_description.upper_height_m: Upper edge of the protected vertical range; it must be higher than the lower edge.
data_description.lateral_min_m: Optional lateral boundary. Enter both lateral values or leave both empty.
data_description.lateral_max_m: Optional lateral boundary. It must be greater than the start value.

data_description.target_position: Requested cover position while this zone protects against glare.
data_description.target_tilt: Optional slat position for the protection case.

data_description.window_width_m: Width of the light-transmitting window surface.
data_description.window_height_m: Height of the light-transmitting window surface.
data_description.window_sill_height_m: Height from the finished floor to the bottom edge of the light-transmitting window surface.
data_description.target_lateral_center_m: Lateral offset of the protected-area centre from the window centre.
data_description.target_lateral_width_m: Width of the area that should be protected from direct sun.

protected_zone_object.name: Protected object relative to the window
protected_zone_object.description: Use the centre of the object area that must remain out of direct sun. Horizontal offsets are measured from the window centre; heights are measured from the finished floor.

data.object_lateral_center_m: Object centre left/right of window centre

data_description.object_distance_m: Shortest horizontal distance from the window plane to the protected object area.
data_description.object_center_height_m: Height from the finished floor to the centre of the protected object area.
data_description.object_height_m: Total vertical height of the area that must stay shaded.
data_description.object_lateral_center_m: Horizontal offset of the object centre: negative is left and positive is right when looking into the room.
data_description.object_width_m: Total horizontal width of the area that must stay shaded.

data_description.delete_protected_zone: Opens a separate confirmation before the stable zone is removed.

delete_protected_zone.title: {sector_name} · Remove protected zone
delete_protected_zone.description: This deletes the protected zone and its locally stored geometry and target settings from this sector.

data_description.confirm_delete_protected_zone: Only confirm when this protected zone should be permanently removed.

add_sector_group.title: {sector_name} · Create first cover group
add_sector_group.description: Every new sun sector requires a cover group. Select its physical profile now.

data_description.name: Name shown for this group.
data_description.profile: Determines available settings, defaults and card behavior.

add_sector_covers.title: {sector_name} · Assign covers
add_sector_covers.description: The new sun sector is saved only after at least one cover is assigned to its first group.

data_description.cover_entities: Select every Home Assistant cover that should move with this group.

add_group_covers.title: {group_name} · Assign covers
add_group_covers.description: The new cover group is saved only after at least one cover is assigned.

data_description.cover_entities: The selected covers inherit this group’s physical profile and targets.

error.temperature_order: Comfort shading must start below solar shading, and solar shading below heat protection.
error.lux_hysteresis: The ON lux threshold must be higher than the OFF lux threshold.
error.elevation_order: The four sun elevations must be strictly increasing.
error.cover_already_assigned: At least one selected cover is already assigned within this house.
error.normal_temperature_order: Required order: reopen < normal shading < heat protection.
error.cannot_delete_last_room: A Smart Shading entry must keep at least one room. Add another room first.
error.cannot_delete_last_sector: A room must keep at least one sun sector. Add another sector first.
error.cannot_delete_last_layer: A sector must keep at least one cover group. Add another group first.
error.cannot_delete_last_cover: A cover group must keep at least one cover. Add another cover first.
error.night_entity_required: Select a schedule or on/off entity for the night function.
error.pause_requires_night: This pause duration requires an enabled night function.
error.option_not_available: This function is not available in this setup.
error.incomplete_configuration: Resolve the open items shown in the summary before saving changes.
error.sun_source_required: Select the entity required by this sun source.
error.occupancy_source_required: Select an occupancy sensor or turn off the occupancy requirement.
error.protected_zone_name_required: Enter a name for the protected zone.
error.protected_zone_groups_required: Select at least one affected cover group.
error.protected_zone_group_invalid: Every selected cover group must belong to this sun sector.
error.protected_zone_distance_range: The facade distance must be between 0.1 m and 30 m.
error.protected_zone_height_range: The lower protected height must be below the upper height, within 0 m to 10 m.
error.protected_zone_lateral_range: Enter both lateral values and make sure the start is below the end.
error.protected_zone_target_range: Target positions must be between 0% and 100%.
error.protected_zone_single_group_required: Select exactly one cover group for automatic calculation.
error.protected_zone_profile_not_supported: Automatic glare calculation is not useful for the selected cover type. Choose an individually controlled roller, screen, curtain, vertical blind or binary cover.
error.protected_zone_cover_required: Select the one physical cover that belongs to this window.
error.protected_zone_cover_invalid: The selected cover is not available in this sun sector or its cover type cannot use this calculation.
error.protected_zone_window_geometry_range: Enter sensible window dimensions and its bottom edge above the floor.
error.protected_zone_object_geometry_range: Enter a valid object distance, centre, width and height. The object must remain above the floor.

abort.no_rooms: No rooms have been configured yet.

options.open: Open covers or move to neutral position

options.any: At least one condition may pass

options.move_safe: Actively move covers to safety position

preview_day.name: Preview a shading day
preview_day.description: Creates a non-actuating shading preview for a selected local date. It evaluates the production decision pipeline but never calls a cover service or command executor.

room_id.name: Room ID
room_id.description: Stable Smart Shading room ID from the room status entity.

date.name: Date
date.description: Local calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

entry_id.name: Configuration entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional Smart Shading configuration entry identifier.
